baseline.architecture: LoRAT-L/378 with trained LoRA, token embeddings and MLP head; synchronous current-frame YOLO; V3 output separation
baseline.scope: Research baseline chosen from development Val132; not a new Test420 result or replacement of historical V4 records
research_extensions: D temporal candidate association with explicit KEEP_B action
E zero-initialized spatial residual in LoRAT search-token head input

D.source: Frozen B_POOL train rollout features, all stored samples with exact B output represented in the pool
D.supervision: IoU quality BCE plus equal-weight SmoothL1 relative IoU utility against KEEP_B; no class-prior rebalancing
D.sampling: Uniform valid stored training query samples; identical sample draws for D0 and D
D.temporal: GRU over three strictly past fixed-clock feature snapshots and current candidate; frame gaps and geometry explicit
D.static_control: D0 has identical model and losses but masks all historical observations
D.controller: Original B default output/state retained until a higher-valued candidate confirms on three consecutive selected observations with common branch membership; local and global streaks cannot mix
D.identity_limit: Branch IDs are geometric association cues, never target identity labels or model input numbers
D.history_write_rule: frame modulo 8 only; never use GT-dependent retained-sample cadence at runtime
D.initialization: Zero last value layer produces exact KEEP_B; complete D_ZERO validation must reproduce B predictions
D.checkpoint_selection: Last fixed epoch; no validation checkpoint selection

E.architecture: Frozen B plus search-grid residual: LayerNorm,1024-to-64,GELU,depthwise3x3,GELU,zero-initialized64-to-1024; original head retained
E.base_model: All B parameters frozen, only spatial residual trained
E.sampling: Same fixed-first-frame PairDataset as B; 50 percent uniform visible, 50 percent smaller-half frames per uniformly sampled sequence
E.initialization: Complete E_ZERO validation must reproduce B predictions
E.limitation: No extra pixels or increased backbone resolution; tests local grid/box-regression refinement, not information recovery
E.checkpoint_selection: Last fixed epoch; no validation checkpoint selection

validation_limit: Existing development Val132 previously used for YOLO and C inspection, not blind validation; one seed research run
